Main dataset upload of the Load Data wizard

Source: R/wizard-upload_box.R
upload_box_ui.Rd

The upload zone of the wizard's Upload Data step, where the user gives the health facility data the whole analysis runs on: an Excel file (.xls, .xlsx), a Stata file (.dta) or a saved dataset (.rds). The server reads the file and makes the dataset (a CacheConnection) that every other step works on. A file that cannot be read shows an error banner under the zone. The zone's reset button removes the dataset, which locks the later steps again. A button downloads the merged data as a Stata file. The Upload Data step counts as complete once a dataset is loaded (see step_upload_complete()).

Usage

upload_box_ui(id, i18n, is_electron = FALSE)

upload_box_server(id, i18n, cdsuite_file, is_electron = FALSE)

Arguments

id

The module's id.

i18n

The app's translator (a shiny.i18n translator), used for every label.

is_electron

TRUE when the app was started with a file to load (the desktop app), FALSE (the default) when the user picks the file in the page. The ui and the server must be given the same value.

cdsuite_file

The path of the file the app was started with, a string, or NA_character_ when it was started without one.

Value

upload_box_ui() returns the UI as Shiny tags: the upload zone (left out when is_electron is TRUE), the placeholder for the status banner and the download button. It has no card of its own. upload_box_server() returns a list with three elements:

  • cache: a reactive that returns the dataset, a CacheConnection, or NULL when none is loaded;

  • requires_walkthrough: a reactive value that is TRUE when the wizard must be walked through step by step, and FALSE when a saved dataset (.rds) was loaded;

  • source_path: a reactive value that holds the path Finish saves the dataset next to (the dataset folder and the file's name), or NULL when a saved dataset was loaded or nothing is loaded.

Details

How a file is loaded depends on its type:

  • Excel: the sheets are read with load_excel_parts() and kept unmerged in the dataset (wizard_parts) until the user presses Finish. The country is worked out from the admin sheet and stored with set_wizard_country().

  • Stata: the file is loaded with load_cache_data(), without validation. A copy is saved when the user presses Finish, as for Excel.

  • .rds: a saved dataset is loaded with load_cache_data() too, and needs no walkthrough.

A Stata file or a saved dataset built for another indicator group than the app's is refused (cd_wizard_check_group()).

An Excel or Stata file that has a saved copy from an earlier Finish (named by cd_saved_copy_name(), in the dataset folder) loads that copy in its place, so the user does not go through the walkthrough again. When the copy cannot be read, the original file is loaded. The dataset folder is the folder of cdsuite_file when the app was started with a file, and otherwise datasets under tools::R_user_dir("cd2030", "data").

When the app is started with a file (is_electron = TRUE) there is no upload zone: the server loads cdsuite_file once at startup and shows a success or an error banner.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# in a module's ui: the user picks the file in the page
upload_box_ui(ns("upload_box"), i18n)

# in its server
upload <- upload_box_server("upload_box", i18n, cdsuite_file = NA_character_)
observe({
  req(upload$cache())
  message("Loaded ", upload$cache()$country, "; walkthrough: ", upload$requires_walkthrough())
})

# an app started with a file to load: no upload zone, the file is loaded at startup
upload_box_ui(ns("upload_box"), i18n, is_electron = TRUE)
upload <- upload_box_server("upload_box", i18n, "C:/data/Kenya.xlsx", is_electron = TRUE)
} # }
